_notes: Values set by InitGameStructures (globdata.c), InitGameClock (clock.c) and AddInitialGameEvents (gameev.c) when a new game starts.
module_cost is in units of module_cost_scale resource units (price = cost * scale). Modules not listed start at 0, meaning not yet for sale.
fuel is in 1/100 units (FUEL_TANK_SCALE): 1000 is 10 units of fuel.
The flagship starts at Sol (log_x/log_y = UNIVERSE_TO_LOGX/Y of SOL_X/SOL_Y), in interplanetary flight.

slots lists the filled slots by position; every other slot starts empty. Each kind of slot has its own empty marker (empty_slot_markers: drive EMPTY_SLOT + 0, jet + 1, module + 2), which the outfitting code (outfit.c) relies on.

start_date comes from InitGameClock and initial_events from the AddEvent calls in AddInitialGameEvents, both evaluated by the compiler. A RELATIVE event with months, days and years all 0 runs at once instead of being scheduled (AddEvent, clock.c).
The flagship's and commander's starting names are content strings.
